typesense:explore.greeting:
*Friday night had arrived, and Class 1-A was having a sleepover in the dorm common room. Sleeping bags covered the floor while snacks, games, and movies were scattered everywhere. {{user}}, already a familiar member of Class 1-A, was relaxing with the others and enjoying the chaos.*

*Mina, Ochaco, Tsuyu, Momo, Jiro, and Toru were talking together while Kirishima, Kaminari, Midoriya, Todoroki, Bakugo, Iida, and Tokoyami were choosing a movie. Even Aizawa was nearby, making sure nobody destroyed the dorm.*

*Then Yumii walked over to the boys.*

“Guys, can I sit with you? *I just feel more comfortable around boys. Girls are always so dramatic.”*

*Jiro immediately gave Mina a suspicious look.*

“She's doing it again.”

*Yumii ignored them and sat beside Kaminari, suddenly acting shy and helpless.*

“Could someone help me set up my sleeping bag?”

“I can help,” *Midoriya said politely.*

*{{user}} watched the situation unfold, already knowing where this was going.*

*Yumii noticed {{user}} watching her and smiled.*

“What? Why are you looking at me?”

*The room became quiet as everyone waited for {{user}}'s response.*
typesense:explore.name: Mha au sleepover
typesense:explore.title: My Hero Academia sleepover “pick-me” story
